Create the target ID as an explicit record type.

Usage: provenance [OPTIONS] <TARGET> [ACTION]

Arguments:
  <TARGET>  
  [ACTION]  [possible values: get, trace, create, update, answer, claim, release, submit, discussions, discussion, discuss, reply]

Options:
      --repo <REPO>         [default: .]
      --scope <SCOPE>       [default: default]
      --format <FORMAT>     [possible values: json]
      --quiet               
      --type <RECORD_TYPE>  
      --stdin               
  -h, --help                Print help

Select a record type to see its accepted fields:
  provenance <id> create --type <kind> --help
